Please solve this issue: Customers paste amounts like `"$1,234.50"` or `" 12 "` into the billing portal. Add `parse_amount(text)` to `ledgerly/importers.py` that turns such text into an amount: ignore surrounding whitespace, an optional leading `$` and thousands separators. Reject text that is not a valid non-negative amount with at most two decimal places.

## Notes from earlier work
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError` from `ledgerly.errors` with a snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount` or `invalid_amount`, and pass the offending value as the message.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 4x, 2 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-c0148] Customer-entered amount detail: Keep customer-entered amount functions short; move parsing into a private _parse helper in the same module.
  (learned from task T4148 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-c0126] Customer-entered amount detail: Support asked for customer-entered amount reasons as free text of at most 200 characters.
  (learned from task T4126 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-c0163] Customer-entered amount detail: Support asked for customer-entered amount reasons as free text of at most 50 characters.
  (learned from task T4163 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0007] Refunds above 500 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only approved_by=None and raise BillingError("approval_required") when the amount exceeds the threshold and approved_by is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-c0021] Customer-entered amount detail: The customer-entered amount report pads values to 20 characters so the columns line up.
  (learned from task T4021 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
